description:
FILED s451 (Fable, from agent Y ask 1).  The MESSAGE column of baselines/parse-error-drop-census-s399.tsv is stale TREE-WIDE: s440 swapped Data::Dump for the core Data::Dumper in Pl::PExpr::_dd, and the compiler drop message text changed shape, so every blessed row message is truncated at the first "[" and no longer matches what the compiler prints.  COUNTS are the baseline and are correct (the s451 Mojo _Collection.pm row was a separate stale COUNT, 2->4, verified on 718db6b and edited s451); the message column is context for row edits and should be refreshed ONCE: run tools/drop-census.pl over all populations, verify every COUNT byte-identical to the blessed file, and update ONLY the message text.  A count that moves during the refresh is a finding, not a refresh -- stop and attribute it.  Bundle with any census-touching session.
--- DONE s456ah (Opus agent AH, round 13) ---
Refreshed ONCE, message text only, from a full `tools/drop-census.pl . OUT 8
--board` on 49e55ad.  The refresh script ASSERTS, before it will write, that
the file SET and every per-file COUNT are byte-identical to the blessed file
and refuses otherwise (a count that moves during a text refresh is a finding,
not a refresh).  They were: 21 files / 65 drops, unchanged, and the path+count
columns are byte-identical after the edit.  11 of 21 message texts moved; the
rows keep their blessed ORDER so the diff is message text alone.  The header
carries the s456ah edit note.  Nothing consumes the message column --
sweep-diff.pl's load_drop_census reads path + count only.
